verdict.rationale: A natural-language operating interface, such as a copilot or chat assistant for the Customer Portal or API, is a reasonable axis for an identity-verification SaaS, so the story applies. The evidence shows only a REST API, SDKs, webhooks, manual portal review, a no-code Zapier integration and an llms.txt docs index. None of these let a user operate Veriff through natural-language commands.
